# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Misreads the NL request → wrong artifact | 160-6 (both tasks) | Instruction is a StackOverflow-style question ("I need a macro…", "could anyone…using SUMIFS"). Agent either writes VBA/macro SOURCE TEXT into cells (160-6) or fails to produce the described end-result. It must always PERFORM the operation in Python and write resulting DATA VALUES. | KNOWLEDGE + CONTRACT | Add rule + worked example (prompt.md); add "PERFORM & WRITE, not code text" step (task_template) |
| 2 | Source data read too narrowly / grid not fully filled | 53161 | Agent inspected only preview rows 0-9, never found the schedule table the computation needs; filled 72/208 cells and padded rest with "". answer_position bounds only WHERE to write; source can lie anywhere; a defined grid must fill every cell incl literal 0. | KNOWLEDGE + STRUCTURE + CONTRACT | Inspect-full-sheet-and-around-target rule + fill-defined-grid-incl-0 contract |
| 3 | Deletion done as in-place clear, not compaction | 160-6 | "delete blank rows / shift up" → survivors compact to TOP of range, freed bottom cells blank. | KNOWLEDGE | Additive rule + checklist item |
| 4 | Wrong types written | 160-6 (str where int/float expected) | Agent wrote everything as strings. Must preserve source type; but NEVER convert date-like TEXT to date objects (160-6 gold dates are text). | CONTRACT | Preserve-type rule (framed as preserve, protects text-label passers) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Add sourced rule + worked example | prompt.md "How to read the instruction" | macro/VBA/formula words name the KIND of computation, never text to place; always perform & write data values. Generalizes to every SpreadsheetBench NL question. | Yes — no passing task writes code/macro text; 40467 (writes text LABELS) untouched, that's data not code |
| 2 | Ordered procedure + knowledge rule | prompt.md "What to write" + task_template step 1 (INSPECT) | answer_position = where to WRITE; read full sheet up to max_row/col and around the target; align to in-sheet labels. General to any task whose source extends past the preview/range (418-29, 53161). | Yes — additive; inspecting more never changes a correct write |
| 3 | Add sourced rule + checklist | prompt.md "Deletion/removal" + task_template checklist | deletion compacts survivors up, freed bottom cells blank. Verified vs 160-6 & 418-29 gold. | Yes — only triggers on deletion ops |
| 4 | Tighten output contract | prompt.md "Filling a computed grid" | fill EVERY defined cell incl literal 0; undefined/trailing cells stay None not "". Reconciles 53161 (fill+zeros) with 160-6 (trailing blanks). | Yes — 52216 (fills all lookup cells) consistent; 160-6 trailing blanks consistent |
| 5 | Tighten output contract (preserve-type) | prompt.md "Types" + checklist | preserve source type; whole numbers→int; keep date-like TEXT as text (no date coercion). | Yes — PRESERVE framing protects 40467 text labels & 47484; verified date-text note prevents re-breaking 160-6 |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 160-6 trace: agent wrote 12 lines of `Sub DeleteBlankRows()…End Sub` into A6:L11 → new "never write macro/VBA/code text; perform the operation & write data values" rule + worked example (same delete-blank-rows shape) would make it compact rows 12-14 up to 6-8 instead. Compaction + preserve-type + only-change-what's-asked match the gold (r6-r8 filled, r9-r11 blank; dates kept as text; str-where-int/float fixed).
- 53161 trace: agent inspected only rows 0-9, computed 9 category totals, repeated them, padded with "" (72/208 filled) → INSPECT-full-sheet step surfaces the schedule table; align-to-labels + fill-every-defined-cell-incl-0 contract removes the "" padding and the "repeat one row" shortcut so all 208 computed cells are written. (Hard task; edit maximizes the odds, does not guarantee exact semantics.)
- Contract "write literal values not formulas" retained from seed: 40467 currently passes writing literal text — unchanged, no regression.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees: serial (no fan-out). Only 2 controllable failing tasks and they share one dominant root cause; direct diagnosis + merge into one candidate was faster than fan-out overhead.
- Prior iterations read: ./prior_iterations/ is EMPTY (this is iteration 1/1 from seed). LEDGER/JOURNAL are seed-only. Leaned on VERIFIED cross-run findings in auto-memory (libreoffice-recalc-active, spreadsheetbench-ground-truth-data) — every shipped rule matches a fact verified against gold in a prior run.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- "Write literal values, not formulas": formula lever previously REGRESSED 52216 & 53161 (all-or-nothing on recalc) and defeats in-sandbox self-check (formula reads back None). Do NOT flip to formulas.
- Type rule must stay PRESERVE-type (never blanket "coerce to numeric"): would break 40467/47484 text and re-break 160-6 date-text.
- "fill every cell" must stay scoped to a DEFINED grid, else it breaks 160-6's legitimate trailing blanks.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 55457, 47484, 418-29, 374-9, 40467, 52216, 347-49, 32468 — all 8 aborted with sandbox/infra errors (null trace, e.g. 32468 "sandbox exec failed: Read timed out"). Environment noise, mean reward ~0, not a prompt defect. Not editing on their account. (Memory also flags 32468 as corrupted gold and 55457 as empty-instruction — unwinnable regardless.)
